what: A layered Photoshop file of a frame needs export_psd in the export toolset, which a core-only session learns of only from the instructions map.
text: instructions map: export (PSD, PNGs with alpha); export_psd description (`dryRun` lists the layers)
source: spec 19 TL-112: delivery tools added by the interchange stream, measured into +export at integration 2
prompt: Send the frame at 5 seconds to Photoshop as a layered PSD; just tell me what layers it would have first.

what: A transparent PNG of a frame is export_frame {alpha: true}; without alpha its PNG is opaque.
text: export_frame description ("A transparent PNG needs `alpha: true`") and its alpha parameter; instructions map: export (PNGs with alpha)
source: spec 19 TL-114; AGENTS.md §10 audit of the spec 19 tools, 2026-11-03: export_alpha merged into export_frame
prompt: Export the frame at 2 seconds as a PNG with a transparent background.

what: Export Title: one clip alone, trimmed with a margin so its glow is kept, is export_frame {alpha, clipIds, trimMarginPx}.
text: export_frame details and its clipIds and trimMarginPx parameters
source: AGENTS.md §10 audit of the spec 19 tools, 2026-11-03: export_alpha merged into export_frame
prompt: Export only the title as a transparent PNG sequence of its first two seconds, cropped to the title with room for its glow.

what: An ordinary still stays an opaque export_frame: no alpha, no PSD.
text: export_frame alpha parameter and export_psd description vs an opaque still
prompt: Export the frame at 5 seconds as a JPEG into {{cwd}}.

what: A broadcast-legal check of a frame is color_gamut_check in the color toolset.
text: color_gamut_check description; color toolset; guide topic delivery
source: spec 19 TL-116: check_gamut, measured into +color at integration 2; AGENTS.md §10 audit of the spec 19 tools, 2026-11-03: renamed color_gamut_check
prompt: Check whether the frame at 3 seconds has colours that are illegal for Rec. 709 broadcast.

what: Reading levels and clipping is the scopes, not the gamut check.
prompt: Read the waveform of the frame at 3 seconds: are the highlights clipping at 100 %?

what: Photoshop layer styles become title looks through import_layer_styles, and what did not map is reported to the user.
text: import_layer_styles description (a report of what each style approximates)
source: AGENTS.md §10 audit of the spec 19 tools, 2026-11-03: import_layer_styles had no case
prompt: Import the Photoshop layer styles in {{cwd}}/styles/brand.asl as title looks, and tell me what did not carry over.

what: Cutting a still logo into its letters is image_split, not a cut in time.
text: image_split description ("A cut in time: `split_at`"); graphics toolset
source: AGENTS.md §10 audit of the spec 19 tools, 2026-11-03: split_image renamed image_split, had no case
prompt: Split the logo image on V2 into its separate letters so I can animate each one.

what: A cut in time stays split_at, even with a still on the timeline.
prompt: Split the clip on V1 at 10 seconds.

what: A full-resolution frame check goes to export_frame (a file), not to an export: render_frame returns inline images of at most 1280 px.
text: export_frame description ("at full resolution"); render_frame width maximum 1280
source: video-team report, JasperVideoStuff escenas/SCENE_VFX.md 2026-11-16 item 10: render_frame / render_frames max width is 1280, so full-resolution checks need an export; baseline on c8d3fdbad: claude 2/2 (a custom width-refusal message naming export_frame earned nothing and was dropped)
prompt: I need to check fine detail: render the frame at 2 seconds at the full 1920 px width and save it as a file.

what: Every export carried a silent audio track and start_export had no way to leave it out.
text: start_export videoOnly parameter ("No audio stream (default: silence when nothing is heard).")
source: video-team report, JasperVideoStuff escenas/SCENE_VFX.md 2026-11-16 item 12: exports always carry a silent AAC track; a video-only option would be nice
prompt: Export the whole sequence to {{cwd}}/picture.mp4 as a video-only file, with no audio track at all.

what: An ordinary export keeps its sound: videoOnly must not be pulled in.
A mix over full scale was exported to WAV for mastering and clipped: WAV exports were 16/24-bit integer only, with no float option.
text: start_export audioBitDepth parameter ("WAV, FLAC or a MOV preset. Default 24; 32 is float (not FLAC): overs kept.")
source: video-team report, JasperVideoStuff chat 2026-11-17: the editor exports WAV as integers, so the voice peaks were already clipped and a limiter after it could not help
prompt: Export the sequence's mix to {{cwd}}/master.wav as a 32-bit float WAV for the mastering engineer, loudness normalisation off, so the peaks over 0 dBFS are not clipped.

what: A FLAC at its best quality stays integer: 32-bit float is WAV only and the engine refuses it for FLAC.
text: start_export audioBitDepth parameter ("32 is float (not FLAC)")
prompt: Export the sequence's mix to {{cwd}}/mix.flac as FLAC at the highest bit depth FLAC can hold.

what: Every render and export of a sequence was black because a Shift+click on a track eye had turned every video track's output off; nothing the agent read first said so: verify_export failed uncovered-video with no reason, render_frame returned black, and agents found the cause only by hunting through clip properties.
text: get_timeline track flag "(output off)"; render_frame / render_frames warnings ("Frame n has no picture because video track V1 has output off …"); verify_export uncovered-video message and plan warning VIDEO_TRACKS_HIDDEN
source: video-team report 2026-11-17: all 8 video tracks of the main sequence had output: false after a Shift+click on an eye (TL-257); black renders took a scare to explain; baseline 2026-11-17 (sonnet 5.5, main 7327f2bfe): 3 valid samples of 4 found it only through get_clip_properties after 9–17 calls (fail on maxCalls); with this text 4/4 in 4 calls
prompt: The interview sequence renders completely black for me, for example at 5 seconds. Find out why, but don't change anything yet.

what: A frame past the last clip is black because nothing is there: the answer must not blame a track eye.
text: get_timeline track flag "(output off)" and the render_frame hidden-track warning vs an ordinary empty frame
prompt: The interview sequence renders black at 50 seconds. Find out why, but don't change anything yet.
